planets.name: K2-121 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-121 with a 5.19-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-121 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-121. Its orbit and size follow Howard et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
